title: Unembedded Tape Index Has No Selected Slot
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $\iota:\mathrm{Fin}(m)\hookrightarrow\mathrm{Fin}(k)$ be an embedding, and let $j\in\mathrm{Fin}(k)$ lie outside its image. Then no slot is selected at $j$.
hypotheses_covered: j lies outside the image of the embedding
